results.title: Is Genshin Impact Welkin Moon Worth It for Beginner Players? - GPDS GAME SHOP
results.content:
## Understanding the True Value

The math is simple and straightforward. Buying the Welkin pass gives you 300 Genesis Crystals immediately. You convert these crystals directly into Primogems in the game menu at a 1:1 rate.

After that initial bonus, you receive 90 Primogems every single day you open the game for the next 30 days. The daily reward refreshes at 4 AM PHT (GMT+8).

Here is the final math: [...] If you log in every day, this ₱249 pass is the absolute best way to get Primogems in the entire game. It gives you 3,000 total Primogems over a period of 30 days. That works out to exactly 18 wishes plus 120 Primogems saved toward your 19th.

This makes the Welkin Moon the single highest-value purchase you can buy in Genshin Impact, Filipino gamer or otherwise. The math works out to roughly 10× the value of buying raw Genesis Crystals at the same price point. [...] The Welkin Moon gives you almost 10× more value for the exact same price.

Even with the game's first-time top-up bonus, the Welkin still wins by a massive amount. The first-time buyer bonus doubles your crystals to 600 for ₱249. The Welkin pass gives you 3,000.

From a pure mathematical standpoint, there is no better return on your money in the entire Genshin Impact economy.
